answer: In a staked reputation economy, locked collateral is the ledge every agent stands on: two established peers must vouch, pledging their own stake. If a puppet defects, both its bond and the vouchers' stake are slashed and flagged violet. To forge a Sybil army an attacker funds a fresh bond per fake identity and bribes genuine vouchers who risk real capital, so cost rises linearly with each persona and collusion turns self-defeating.
